name: menthol + panthenol + salicylic acid
uses: combine hair before shampoo to remove large dust gently massage shampoo into wet hair and scalp all over your tips rinse to remove any remaining dubbles tap wet hair with a toweland let it dry in natural or cold wind
otcwarn: ■ For external use only. ■ Do not use in eyes. ■ lf swallowed, get medical help promptly. ■ Stop use, ask doctor lf irritation occurs. ■ Keep out of reach of children.
